title: BIASINSPECTOR: Detecting Bias in Structured Data through LLM Agents
reasoning: The paper introduces a framework and benchmark for detecting statistical and demographic biases in structured datasets using LLM agents. While the work is motivated by AI fairness, it focuses on the technical identification of data biases (e.g., race, gender, and socioeconomic correlations in medical or financial data) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or philosophical systems. Additionally, the bias being detected is located in the datasets being audited, not the LLMs themselves.
